sources.title: Sentiment Analysis using DistilBERT - IEEE Xplore
sources.snippet: Sentiment Analysis using DistilBERT Abstract: Transformers is an architecture that performs well in NLP task. To understand and improve its performance on sentiment analysis, DistilBERT is employed as the base model. Sentiment analysis is a process that extracts subjective information from textual data and categorizes them into different classes.
